title: Pen Pal
credits: Words, music, arrangement, voice and picture by Claude. Sung by en_US-amy-medium through Praat PSOLA.
key: G major; the final chorus and outro lift a whole step to A major

lines.text: Save it. Clip it. Insert it. Export it.
Spin the hard disk. Feed the floppy.
Ask the question. Search it. Read it.
Clip the proof. Scrapbook. Keep it.
Outline it. Draft it. Your words. Not mine.
I can fetch. I can file.
I can hum for a while.
But the pen and the page
La la la, la la la la.
La la la, la la la la.
La la la, la la la la.
La la la, la la la la.
Chat is an app. Not the whole computer.
I can check. I can flag.
I could smooth it. I won't.
But the pen and the page
La la la, la la la la.
La la la, la la la la.
it still won't hold the pen.
Save it. Clip it. Insert it. Export it.
La la la, la la la la.
La la la, la la la la.

lead.why: en_US-amy-medium speaks near G3; sung notes stay within ~1.7 octaves above it so PSOLA keeps the words

chant.why: amy with the pitch tier flattened; D3 is the deadpan end-of-list fall

choir.why: written pitches; the production stacks amy + jenny + lessac (lessac an octave down is not notated)

spoken.why: unpitched raw TTS; the note slots are time only

machineVoice.chant: amy, pitch tier flattened to the written note (G3 = her speaking pitch; B3 in verse 1 bars 5-8), no vibrato; durations quantised to the 8th grid; only the vowel nucleus is stretched (duration tier holds onsets/codas at 1.0); doubled an octave down by lessac at -9 dB; 1988 sections add an 8-bit 11 kHz crush; the last word of every list line steps down (to D3 from G3, to G3 from B3); questions stay flat: the robot does not know how to ask
machineVoice.lead: amy singing; gentle vibrato (5.5 Hz, +/-20 cents) on notes of 1 beat or longer; 60 ms portamento only where notes are slurred inside a word
machineVoice.choir: amy + en_GB-jenny_dioco + lessac (an octave down), each offset +/-15 ms and detuned +/-8 cents (roles harmony, lala); the final chorus doubles every voice (6 takes)
machineVoice.gang: roles 'echo', 'gang' and 'call': the choir SHOUTED, 12 copies (one per appearance, each with its own detune and formant tilt), hard-panned wide, +3 dB over the lead on 'You do!' and '(pen pal)', -3 dB under the chant on '(Keep it.)' and 'Flag it.'; a clap stack on every 'Flag' and on both 'You's; the crowd's part
machineVoice.spoken: lessac, raw Piper, no PSOLA; k1 is low-passed to 4 kHz with an 8-bit crush (a sample from a 1988 Mac); o3 is dry and flat, the full-disk-warning voice
machineVoice.chops: the boot teaser's 'pen' (D5) and 'pal' (B4) cut at the word boundary, repitched by PSOLA, 8-bit crushed in the intro, clean in the post-choruses; an instrument, not a line (parts.chops.events: [midi, beat, beats, word])

melt.pre1a / pre2a: flat chant on G3, octave double, crush
melt.pre1b / pre2b: chant with an 80 ms glide between notes (the robot learns portamento); crush lifts; in pre2b a low-pass sweep closes over 'smooth' (8 kHz -> 1.5 kHz across the beat) and 'I won't' is bone dry again
melt.pre1c / pre2c: lead: vibrato arrives, octave double removed
melt.pre1d / pre2d: full lead, hanging on A4 HAND (the 5th of D, a question); the band hits with it and stops; half a beat of air

gags.fade (chorus d lines): level fade and pitch glide B4 -> G4 while the bit depth drops over the beat, into half a beat of real silence: the singer's own output is temporary
gags.smooth (pre2b): a low-pass sweep closes over 'smooth' (the voice's own consonants are smoothed off); 'I won't.' is full-band and dry
gags.chorus3b 'pen' (silent=true): the band drops at +6.5 after 'hold', the lead sings 'the' alone, then the word is not sung: silence from +7, one keystroke at +7.25, the crash and brass slam back on 'You' at +8
gags.v2c 'Too regular?' / 'Flag it.': the chant is perfectly regular on purpose, so Review Desk flags the singer; the band answers with the one-beat stumble (fills.stumble)
gags.v2f_keep 'Keep it.': +/-10 cent detune and 20 ms unquantised onsets on the lead: the one rough line in the song is the one worth keeping
gags.bridge years: chant stacked in octaves, panned; a system beep on every year (parts.beeps)
gags.o2 'voice': the long A4 (outro +11 .. +14) freezes into a two-cycle grain loop for its last half beat (+13.5 .. +14), then the boot chord takes over

machineVoice.qa: faster_whisper small.en must transcribe every line word for word, except the 'lala' lines (judge those by pitch contour; 'la la la la la la la' passes) and the stacked '(pen pal)' echoes and 'You do!' gang (word-level check only). Lines to check alone first: chorus3a/e (E5 'pen'), chorus3h (E5 'You'), v2a ('is an app'), pre2b ('I could smooth it'). If a line fails, lengthen its slowest word or move its echo

silence: the silent pen: the band drops after 'hold', the voice sings 'the' alone, then one beat of nothing but a keystroke at +7.25; the crash slams back on 'You'

bootChord.timbre: saw pad + FM bell on the lower four notes, sharp attack, low-pass opening slowly over 4 beats, then ringing; the top D5 is pad only (no sine 'ding', so it cannot read as a chime); ours, not Apple's

rebootChord.timbre: the boot chord voiced in A, with a crash: the reboot into Liquid Glass

outroChord.timbre: the boot chord in A, ringing to the end, 'played' by the writer's Return key (sfx.keystrokes[1]); the 9th never resolves

riff.name: The Floppy Organ
riff.timbre: percussive combo organ (FluidR3 GM 17) doubled by a numpy 25%-duty pulse; each attack gets a 6 ms downward pitch blip and a very quiet floppy-stepper click (band-passed noise 2-3 kHz, 8 ms); 8-bit 11 kHz sample-and-hold crush in 1988 sections, lifting as the eras advance, fully clean in Liquid Glass

plays.note: full loop, 8-bit 11 kHz crush (1988); the pen-pal chops ride on top
bars 1-4 tacet (drives, drums and chant only); the riff returns at 'Clip the proof' and turns around into the melt
bars 1-2 tacet (the choir IS the riff); bars 3-4 an octave down under the second la-la and the chops
full loop, second organ an octave down; turnaround into pre-chorus 2
an octave down under the la-la and the chops
in A Mixolydian, clean, with the last chant and the choir's la-la on top

cuts: the stumble: the whole groove drops for a beat
the silent pen: the band drops after 'hold', the voice sings 'the' alone, then one beat of nothing but a keystroke at +7.25; the crash slams back on 'You'
riff.flourishNote: three 16ths (G5 B5 D6; A5 C#6 E6 in A) at chorus +31.25/+31.5/+31.75, above the gang's last 'do!', into the next section; organ, doubled by the Writing Bell

glockDouble.what: the Writing Bell doubles the flourish in every chorus and plays the loop on top of the outro (parts.bells)

chops.name: the pen-pal chops
chops.source: the boot teaser: 'pen' (boot +5.5, D5) and 'pal' (boot +6.5, B4), one TTS take each, chopped at the word boundary
chops.patternNote: per 2-bar loop: 'pen' on the riff's long D5 (+1.5), 'pal' on +2.5; bar 2: 'pen' +5.5, a 16th stutter pen-pen at +6.5/+6.75, 'pen' +7, 'pal' +7.5

plays.note: the instrumental hook under the chant, before the first verse
under the second la-la: riff, la-la and chops together
under the la-la, into the bridge

chops.treatment: PSOLA-repitched, 8-bit 11 kHz crush in the intro, clean in the post-choruses; hard-gated to the written length; -4 dB under the lead, centre

bass.name: Two Floppies
bass.what: two floppy-drive stepper motors sing the bass: drive A (left) the roots, drive B (right) the octave and the fifth; their heads move on screen per note
bass.timbre: stepper-motor square wave (pulse 50%, a 30 ms seek chirp on each attack, light drive on the body), A hard left, B hard right; under it in the choruses a sine 808 (parts.sub)

styles.pulse8: the octave bass: drive A the root on every beat, drive B the octave on every 'and' (A B A B ...), sidechain pump from the kick
styles.strut: after Feel It Still, split across the drives: A plays R[0,.75] R[.75,.25] R[2.5,.5] and the chromatic approach [3.5,.5]; B plays the octave [1.5,.5] and the fifth [3,.5]; in bars 1 and 5 drive A starts at +.5 so the bell ping on PEN speaks
styles.long: sustained: A the root, B the fifth (pre-chorus: under the string pad; breakdown: A alone as a soft sine sub, the E2 held through the spin-up riser)

cuts: stop-time after the HAND hit: air, then the a cappella pickup
bar 1 of the breakdown: only the G pedal and the spoken sample
voice and piano, then the boot chord
the silent pen: the band drops after 'hold', the voice sings 'the' alone, then one beat of nothing but a keystroke at +7.25; the crash slams back on 'You'

sub.what: 808 sine sub, one long note an octave under drive A on every chorus chord, plus the bridge sub drop; cut in the silence

drums.gridNote: 16 characters per bar, one per 16th; a pattern of 1/2/4/8 bars repeats through its section

kick.cause: a floppy pops out of its drive icon (the disk slides out one pixel per frame)
kick.synth: the eject clunk pitched down two octaves with a 55 Hz sine body and a 4 ms click; tighter 808-style body in the choruses

snare.cause: a window zooms shut: the zoom outline collapses to its icon
snare.synth: noise burst + 180 Hz body, crunchy, 120 ms

ghostSnare.cause: a window rolls up to its title bar, quietly

clap.cause: the pointer clicks (one click per copy, the copies 8 ms apart: twelve pointers in the final chorus)
clap.synth: three to twelve layered 2 kHz clicks + a short noise tail

hat.cause: one typed character of the writer's solid line (closed hat = a letter)
hat.synth: 6 kHz noise, 40 ms; the key-down click 2 ms before it

openHat.cause: the space bar: the word gap in the typed line
openHat.synth: the hat with a 120 ms tail

crash.cause: Empty Trash: the can bulges, the paper crumples
crash.synth: long noise, 2 s decay; choked (200 ms) on the HAND hits

tambourine.cause: the scroll thumb drags down a long document, the arrows tick

riser.cause: a progress bar fills from empty to full across the riser window
riser.synth: white-noise riser with a rising band-pass (the breakdown's is the floppy spin-up sweep)

stab.cause: the appearance changes era: the whole desk re-skins on the hit
stab.synth: brass section (GM 62) on the chord's upper voicing, 8th-note length

bell.cause: the product's own Writing Bell app rings (the bell icon swings)

keystroke.cause: the writer types one character: 'pen' in the silence, Return at the end
keystroke.synth: a dry key-down click, 2 ms, nothing else

chop.cause: the chat window's speaker grille bars jump on each chop: the AI says its own name
chop.synth: the boot teaser's 'pen' and 'pal', chopped and repitched (PSOLA), 8-bit in 1988 sections

floppyA.cause: drive A's head steps to the note; the drive light blinks
floppyA.synth: stepper-motor square wave with a 30 ms seek chirp, the root notes

floppyB.cause: drive B's head steps to the note
floppyB.synth: the same an octave up / on the fifth

sub.cause: the desktop pattern shakes one pixel
sub.synth: sine sub an octave under drive A, choruses only

beep.cause: the Control Panel picks the next appearance

blip.cause: a chant verb lands in its field

groove.intro / verses / bridge: the big-beat break (Take California): floppy ejects on 1 and the 'a' of 2, window-close on 2 and 4, keystroke 16ths (8ths in the verses), a beep on the 'and' of 4 every second bar
groove.pre-chorus: four on the floor under the progress-bar riser; the band hits HAND and stops
groove.chorus: house / disco: four on the floor, clap stack on 2 and 4, the space-bar open hat on every 'and', closed keystrokes between; the 808 under the drives; crash on 1
groove.post-chorus: Jersey-club bounce: kicks on 1, the 'a' of 1, the 'and' of 2, the 'and' of 3 and 4 (bar 2 adds the bed-squeak 16th), clap stack on 2 and 4, 8th keystrokes; the chops on top
groove.breakdown: checkbox snaps and one click, space
groove.final chorus: the house chorus plus the scroll-bar tambourine 16ths; twelve pointers click the claps

mutes: stop-time after the HAND hit: only the reverse cymbal
the stumble: the groove drops out; only fills.stumble plays
the silent pen: the band drops after 'hold', the voice sings 'the' alone, then one beat of nothing but a keystroke at +7.25; the crash slams back on 'You'

sections.intro: organ riff only, no pads; dry; the pen-pal chops on top of the riff
sections.verse1: bars 1-4: no riff (drives, drums, chant and the typed-verb blips only); bars 5-8 the riff returns and turns around on D5
sections.pre1: string pad (GM 49) sustaining each chord voicing, rising with the riser; the riff drops out; the Writing Bell on 'while'; the whole band hits HAND at +13.5 and stops at +14
sections.chorus1: bouncy offbeat piano 8ths (GM 1) on the chord voicings (Cmaj9 with the D on top); soft saw pad; brass stabs (GM 62) listed in stabs.brass (including both 'You's); the Writing Bell on every 'pen' (stabs.glockPen); one tenor sax (GM 66) stab after 'fade'; the flourish over the last 'do!'
sections.post1: bars 1-2: organ tacet, the choir sings the riff over the Jersey bounce and a vinyl-crackle bed (One More Tune's record); bars 3-4: the organ an octave down, the la-la again, the chops: three hooks at once
sections.verse2: as verse 1 plus a second organ an octave down; the groove drops for the stumble at +19
sections.pre2: as pre-chorus 1, tambourine added; the low-pass sweep on 'smooth'; the bell on 'won't'
sections.chorus2: as chorus 1, tambourine 16ths, choir harmony a third below on bars 5-6
sections.post2: organ riff an octave down, the la-la, the chops, the Jersey bounce; the riser into the bridge
sections.bridge: organ chord stabs on the big-beat kick rhythm (keys.bridgeComp: 16th indices 0, 7, 10 of each bar, bars 1-6); no hats, the twelve beeps (parts.beeps) are the hi-hat; brass on the downbeat and the contact sheet; sub drop on bar 5; bars 7-8 a filter-swept pad, half-time drums building
sections.breakdown: bar 1: a G pedal (sine) and the spoken sample only; bars 2-3: felt piano (GM 1, soft) on the voicings, snaps and claps, lots of space; bar 4: E7sus4 held by the pad over an E2 sine sub while the floppy spin-up riser climbs; no drums; the pickup 'I'm just your' (E4 A4 B4) is a cappella
sections.chorus3: the reboot chord with a crash, then everything in A: piano, pad, brass, bell, 12-copy gang on the echoes and the answer; +6.5 to +8 is the silence window (parts.silence): every part out, one keystroke at +7.25, crash and brass on +8; sax stab after 'fade' and after the last 'do!'
sections.outro: bars 1-2 riff and loop in A under the chant, the choir's la-la on top, the bell on the loop; bar 3 piano and claps under the lead alone (Dmaj9, then E7sus4 suspending under the held 'voice'); bar 4 the Amaj9 boot chord, played by the Return key, resolves under the voice and rings; the spoken line sits over it
sections.tail: the boot chord decaying; one mouse click at saveClick; silence for the end card

keys.voicings: take each chord's 'notes' from the chords list: bass note first, then a close voicing around C4

sfx.uiBlips: one 30 ms sine ping on every chant word that starts on an integer beat (verses, intro, outro): sfx.blips
